FulfmtRoutgCriteria.name: FulfmtRoutgCriteria
FulfmtRoutgCriteria.description: Stores individual fulfillment criteria with their metadata, actions, and activation status within a fulfillment criteria group version.

ConditionExpression.description: A logical expression that combines rule conditions by using identifiers. Defines the logical relationship between conditions.

CanOverrideSplits.description: Indicates whether the routing criteria can override the max splits allowed restriction (true) or not (false). Default value is false.

Description.description: An optional description of the rule.

EndDate.description: An optional end date for the rule. NULL means no end date restriction.

FulfmtRoutgCriteriaGrpVerId.description: A foreign key reference to the rule group version that this rule belongs to. Links the rule to its parent group version.

FulfmtRoutgCriteriaType.description: Determines the criteria type of the rule.

FulfmtRoutgCriteriaUsageType.description: Determines the criteria usage type of the rule.

IsActive.description: Indicates whether the rule is active and included in DRL generation and execution (true) or not (false). Inactive rules are excluded from rule processing.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed it.

Name.description: The name of the criteria. Must be unique within the organization.

RefFulfmtRoutgCriteria.description: A foreign key that points to the parent rule version. NULL for the first version of a rule.

ScoringType.description: Determines how scores are calculated for custom weighted rules. Null for template weighted rules.

ScoringTypeMetadata.description: The metadata for scoring configuration stored as JSON for custom weighted rules. Null for template weighted rules.

StartDate.description: An optional start date for the rule. NULL means no start date restriction.

TemplateName.description: Determines the template name for the rule.

Type.description: Determines how the rule operates and what actions it can perform.

Weight.description: The numeric value that determines the relative importance of this rule in scoring calculations. NULL for filter rules.
